title: Dither
description: Beatles covers as one-bit art on a 1985 black and white desktop. Drag along the four methods, threshold, Bayer, Floyd–Steinberg and Atkinson, and the cover dissolves pixel by pixel from one to the next; a tiny arrow cursor plays with it on its own until you take over.
intent: A screenshot from 1985 that is actually beautiful: crisp one-bit window chrome, a hand-drawn bitmap font, real album art re-dithered live, and a HyperCard-style dissolve as the transition between algorithms, scrubbed directly by the radio column or by dragging across the cover.
sources: herb reference board: bitmap type and lo-fi degradation as beauty
